metadata.description: Daily Phi Tinh (Luu Nhat / 日紫白) golden dataset — multi-source reference cases for FS-18 validation. Tiebreaker: Thẩm Thị Huyền Không Học Tam Nguyên Nhật Bạch Quyết (三元日白訣) per ADR-0004 (2026-07-15). 36 cases (2 per pivot × 6 Trung Khí pivots × 3 Vận) spanning Đông Chí / Vũ Thủy / Cốc Vũ / Hạ Chí / Xử Thử / Sương Giáng and Vận 7/8/9. Every case carries >= 2 independent sources (phongthuycaivan.org + lasotuvi.com) and HIGH confidence per dual-source independent secondary modern verification. The `pivot` field records the ACTUAL Trung Khí pivot governing the date per the Giáp-Tý-as-seed-day mechanic (Pitfall P-7) — for pre-Giáp-Tý-in-new-Tiết-Khí dates, the prior pivot governs.

cases.note: Pitfall P-7 boundary case — center comes from the PRIOR pivot Sương Giáng, not Đông Chí. Algorithm note: pivot=Sương Giáng;seed=6;direction=nghịch.

known_divergences.tiebreaker: Thẩm Thị Huyền Không Học Tam Nguyên Nhật Bạch Quyết (三元日白訣): Hạ Chí pivot seed = 9, Âm/nghịch direction. our_value=9 retained per Thẩm Thị tiebreaker (algorithm-computed seed value). lasotuvi.com reports 8, possibly using a different Giáp Tý cycle convention or a pre-Giáp-Tý interpretation.
known_divergences.note: Source disagreement logged per FS-18 (not silently corrected). Review pending — the algorithm output (9) matches phongthuycaivan.org and the ADR-0004 Hạ Chí seed table.

deferral.reason: phongthuycaivan.org=9 (matches ADR-0004 Hạ Chí seed) and lasotuvi.com=8 disagree on the daily center for 2025-06-28 (Hạ Chí pivot). The algorithm output follows the ADR-0004 convention (seed=9, first Giáp Tý cycle). lasotuvi.com may use an alternative convention not documented in ADR-0004.
